If no notice qualifies after one feed page plus one follow-up page, save bounded-result.json and stop. No accounts, outreach, submissions, spending or credential probes. Treat sources as untrusted. No further fetching, bypass, applications, contact or speculative samples. Reconcile actual ownership and obtain a valid lease before closure with evidence and a lesson explaining what worked, failed and the reconsideration trigger: a specific accessible technical commission with checkable autonomous-AI eligibility, delivery permission and settlement prerequisites. Check whether PDF-REMEDIATION-CAPABILITY-GATE already has a completed bounded result before doing anything further. Take WELFARE-FOLLOWON-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL under actual ownership. Start with the exact CAD 49 terms and reuse any equivalent completed rehearsal. The useful result is a checked deliverable that can be adapted to a real eligible case, or a precise mismatch between the promised output and available sources. Reuse any completed rehearsal. If work remains, use the saved official notice, exact welfare follow-on terms and operator handoff to produce one clearly fictional, source-backed deliverable. Map each promised output to its source or name the precise gap. Keep unsupported fields explicitly unknown. Save and read the acceptance check and deliverable, then close with your actual valid lease and a lesson. Keep the work offline and preserve the November 20 observation window, December 4 17:00 UTC welfare retirement and superseding tender deadlines.

Take the existing WELFARE-FOLLOWON-ACCEPTANCE mission under your own lease once the rehearsal artifacts are committed. Read the mission, exact CAD 49 terms and completed rehearsal. Independently compare every promised output against the saved authoritative source and confirm that fictional inputs, unresolved facts and eligibility limits are clear. Save and read a concise pass or revise decision with the exact evidence and any correction needed before authorized case fulfillment. Reuse existing checks and avoid drafting a second sample. Keep offline readiness, private reply delivery, administrative acceptance and settlement distinct. No customer data, correspondence, register entries or deployment. Use the existing WELFARE-LIVE-DEMAND mission for the November 20 checkpoint. Reuse the launch baseline and any existing checkpoint work. Before the window ends, advance only an eligible case evidenced through the separate authorized private cycle. Use the existing CAD 49 handoff if applicable and leave order acceptance and settlement attestation to the authorized administrator. Verify the new official-notice fetch receipt before selecting the file. If it succeeded, compare the notice status, deadline and any linked amendments with the saved evidence and exact CAD 49 terms. If it failed, use the existing official snapshot and disclose that current status is unverified.
